title: Concept: Yarn lockfile pins an absolute registry URL
description: yarn.lock declares a resolution that hard-codes a registry tarball URL instead of a version range, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The lockfile stops following the configured registry, so a mirror, an air-gapped build or a policy change cannot redirect it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through yarn.lock (npm).
risk: The lockfile stops following the configured registry, so a mirror, an air-gapped build or a policy change cannot redirect it.
